resources.string: Key uses (above every previously used index)

Enter your seed phrase, key uses and the address of a Minima MegaMMR node. Match the original wallet mode in Startup Params before restoring: the same seed produces different addresses in classic and block modes.\n\nEnter a key-use floor above every index previously used by that wallet. The current chain height alone does not prove an index is unused. Stop the original wallet before restoring.
